_note: Everything past the basics is opened through adventures. Each unlock has 'earn': every condition must be met ('find': a special item a pet brought home from a trip, see 'finds' and the events that give them; 'first': the first of something, 'part' or 'toy'; 'trips': adventures welcomed back; 'machine': a node on the machine's tree is fixed; 'packs_opened': packs you opened yourself; 'open': another unlock id that must be open already, e.g. 'feature:parts'; 'taught': a job your pet has been taught in the automation tab (data/automation.json); 'job_level': { job id: level } an errand's level, see data/errands.json). 'show' is how it looks until then: 'locked' (a tab with a padlock and the 'hint') or 'hidden' (not there at all). 'opens' is what it turns on: 'tab:<name>', 'feature:<id>' (errands, packs = the automation tab's open boxes job, auto_adventures = its run adventures job, shopping = your pet buys more boxes when the pile runs out, parties, whistle = your pet manages the workers) 'page:<id>' (a map page) or 'job:<id>' (an errand, see its 'needs'); new_homes = the new homes stall on the pets tab, sorting = its sorting rule card. More earn conditions: 'room': 'full' (the room has been full once), 'homes_by_hand': pets sent to new homes from the stall. 'quiet': true opens it without the popup card (your pet just says the 'announce' line). 'pet_job': a pet comes with it and starts on that errand. 'announce' is what your active pet says when it opens. 'popup' is the card that pops up then: its 'title', a line of 'text' on what it does, and 'go', the tab its show me button opens (none: just lovely).
